name: Shijiazhuang Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
developer: Shijiazhuang Luquan District Big Data Center / CECloud ecosystem
notes: Municipal source says the center was built in four months and phase 1 100P computing power went online for testing on 2023-12-28.

name: Wanlian Cloud Data Center
notes: China Cyberspace Administration reprint described a 5-floor plus 2-basement data center with 36 modular computer rooms, 5,000 standard cabinets planned, and 1,000 cabinets in phase 1 due online by end-2020; later People Finance article said phase 1 had entered operation.

name: China Mobile (Hebei Shijiazhuang) Data Center
notes: CAC reprint reported the China Mobile Hebei Shijiazhuang data center was under construction and, when fully built, would provide about 30,000 racks; Shijiazhuang Mobile also operated three self-built data-center rooms with about 31,000 racks.

name: Tangshan Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
notes: Developer page lists the Tangshan AI Computing Center as a 30-mu, A-level green low-carbon intelligent computing center supporting nearly 10,000 servers.

name: Xingtai Taihang Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Xingtai High-tech Zone / Sichuan Bingji Technology / China Telecom involvement reported
notes: Xingtai government and People.cn report a 2025-02-19 lighting ceremony with 2,000P online, 3,000P more planned by end-April, and phase 1 totaling 5,000P; total investment about RMB 5 billion.

name: Zhangjiakou Data Center Cluster (Jing-Jin-Ji National Computing Hub)
developer: National Development and Reform Commission / Hebei, Beijing and Tianjin authorities
notes: NDRC approved the Jing-Jin-Ji national computing hub and set Zhangjiakou as the data-center cluster, with Huailai County, Zhangbei County and Xuanhua District as initial areas.

name: Hylink Data (Huailai) Technology Industrial Park
notes: Hebei industry department says the Huailai park has 700 MW of IT capacity in operation, more than 50% green power use, and ND11 selected for the 2025 national green data center list.

name: China Unicom (Huailai) Big Data Innovation Industrial Park
notes: Report states the Huailai Unicom park began operation in July 2023 and is an operator-grade large campus data center in the Zhangjiakou cluster; NDRC notes field research at Unicom's key Jing-Jin-Ji node project.

name: China Mobile Jing-Jin-Ji (Zhangjiakou) Data Center
notes: Digital Hebei action-plan coverage lists China Mobile Jing-Jin-Ji (Zhangjiakou) Data Center among key projects to build in the Zhangjiakou data center cluster.

name: China Telecom Huailai Smart Cloud Base
notes: Digital Hebei action-plan coverage lists China Telecom Huailai Smart Cloud Base among key Zhangjiakou cluster projects.

name: Alibaba Cloud Zhangbei / Zhongdu Grassland Data Center Campus
notes: DCD reported Alibaba's Zhangbei cloud base as an RMB 18 billion project; Xiongan/Hebei report says Aliyunlian opened in 2016 and Alibaba had five Zhangjiakou data projects with 280,000 servers by end-2019.

name: Chindata Capital-Area Nanshan Information Technology Industrial Base
notes: Hebei/Xiongan report says Chindata signed its capital-area Nanshan information technology industrial base project in Zhangjiakou in early 2020; Chindata materials describe its pan-Beijing hyperscale cluster extending to Zhangjiakou.

name: Zhangjiakou Mingwei Jingxi Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: ZDATA news mentions Zhangjiakou Mingwei Jingxi cloud computing data center as a Yu County key project; Zhangjiakou recruitment notice says the intelligent-computing center project planned about RMB 20.5 billion total investment with first computing power delivery expected by late January 2025.

name: Daqing Huawei Cloud Data Center
developer: Huawei Cloud / Daqing municipal digital infrastructure partners
notes: Guangming Daily reports Daqing Huawei Cloud Data Center had brought more than 1,200 cloud hosts online as part of Daqing's digital infrastructure build-out.

name: Digital Longjiang (Daqing) China Unicom Big Data Cluster
developer: Daqing municipal government / China Unicom Cloud Data / China Unicom Heilongjiang
notes: China Cyberspace Administration reprint says Daqing signed a strategic cooperation framework with China Unicom to lay out and build a secondary-core big-data cluster in Daqing.

name: Xingtong Huirong Space-Air Intelligent Computing Center, Jiagedaqi
developer: Daxing'anling Xingtong Huirong Intelligent Computing Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Industry project roundup reports备案 for a Jiagedaqi District space-air intelligent computing center: RMB 6.38 billion total investment, phase 1 5,000P and phase 2 5,000P FP16 sparse computing, using green wind power direct supply; use as aggregate evidence pending primary备案 link.

name: China Mobile Harbin Data Center
notes: CNR reports the Harbin data center in Hanan Industrial New City covers 1,294 mu, plans about 600,000 sq m, has more than 160,000 sq m built and can provide 18,000 racks; it is a national green/new data center and China Mobile diamond five-star facility.

name: China Mobile Intelligent Computing Center (Harbin National Node)
notes: CLS and Heilongjiang government coverage report the Harbin national node is in operation with 6.93 EFLOPS / 6,930P computing power, over 18,000 AI accelerator cards, RMB 12 billion planned investment and 70,000 planned racks across 18 computer-room buildings.

name: Digital Longjiang Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Daowai District Government / Zhongke Heilongjiang Digital Economy Research Institute partners
notes: CLS reports the Daowai District project is one of Heilongjiang's first AI computing centers, with 100P planned: 60P in trial operation and 40P planned by end-2024; project materials describe a two-phase, 14-month build.

name: China Unicom Harbin Green Power Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Heilongjiang government report says the Unicom Harbin green-power AIDC is a group-level five-star data center with 180 MW planned power capacity and 10,000 AIDC cabinets, with two data-center buildings already in operation.

name: China Mobile Harbin Data Center Phase III and related AIDC projects
developer: China Mobile Heilongjiang and other operators
notes: Heilongjiang government coverage says Harbin China Mobile Data Center phase III and other intelligent-computing projects were under construction, with combined scale over 8,000P.

name: Aihui Advanced Computing Center 5000P Intelligent Computing Project
developer: Aihui District / project partner not specified in source
notes: Heihe municipal government article states the Aihui Advanced Computing Center 5000P intelligent-computing project was signed and landed.

name: Yunzhen 5000P Intelligent Computing Center, Aihui District
developer: Yunjing (Heilongjiang) Intelligent Computing Technology Co., Ltd. / Yunzhen Technology
notes: Industry roundup reports备案 approval for an RMB 3 billion Aihui District project: 15,000 sq m site, two frame-structure computing-center buildings, one office building, 500 high-performance servers and 150 20kW IT cabinets, full-load computing scale 5,000P.
